title: Size and position of emblem icon depends on thumbnail's dimensions
line: Link and other emblems on desktop thumbnails now have the same size whatever the image's shape, matching the emblem on ordinary file icons.
explanation: Folder View gets its thumbnails from KIO's KFilePreviewGenerator, which adds emblems with KIconUtils::addOverlays. That function picks the emblem size from the smaller side of the image it paints on, so a 21:9 thumbnail got a tiny emblem and a square one a large one. KIconUtils (kguiaddons) gets an addOverlays() overload that takes the icon size to size the overlays for, still keeping them within the painted icon, and KFilePreviewGenerator passes the view's icon size to it, like Dolphin does since dolphin!917.

commits.message:
KIconUtils: allow sizing overlays for a given icon size

addOverlays() chose the overlay size from the size the icon is painted
at, so previews of different aspect ratios shown at the same icon size
got emblems of different sizes. Add an overload that takes that size.

BUG: 499363

KFilePreviewGenerator: size overlays from the view's icon size

The overlays painted on previews were sized from the preview itself, so
emblems such as the link arrow were tiny on wide images and big on
square ones. Size them from the view's icon size with KIconUtils.

BUG: 499363

patches.diff:
From 572c8c5c9f187dcfbeadb81cea294c83d274ce80 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 02:14:26 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] KFilePreviewGenerator: size overlays from the view's icon
 size

The overlays painted on previews were sized from the preview itself, so
emblems such as the link arrow were tiny on wide images and big on
square ones. Size them from the view's icon size with KIconUtils.

BUG: 499363
---
 src/filewidgets/kfilepreviewgenerator.cpp | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/filewidgets/kfilepreviewgenerator.cpp b/src/filewidgets/kfilepreviewgenerator.cpp
index 1c3358ba9..cc4b5e056 100644
--- a/src/filewidgets/kfilepreviewgenerator.cpp
+++ b/src/filewidgets/kfilepreviewgenerator.cpp
@@ -627,7 +627,8 @@ void KFilePreviewGeneratorPrivate::addToPreviewQueue(const KFileItem &item, cons
     }
 
     const QSize size = icon.size();
-    icon = KIconUtils::addOverlays(icon, item.overlays()).pixmap(size / pixmap.devicePixelRatio(), pixmap.devicePixelRatio());
+    icon = KIconUtils::addOverlays(icon, item.overlays(), Qt::BottomRightCorner, m_viewAdapter->iconSize())
+               .pixmap(size / pixmap.devicePixelRatio(), pixmap.devicePixelRatio());
 
     // remember the preview and URL, so that it can be applied to the model
     // in KFilePreviewGenerator::dispatchIconUpdateQueue()
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Pure master: the link emblem on the 1:1, 16:9, 21:9 and 4:3 link thumbnails has different sizes (tiny on 21:9).
With the fix: the same emblem size on every link thumbnail, matching the link emblem on the plain text file icon.
With the fix at the largest desktop icon size: still the same emblem size on every link thumbnail.

review.text: Clean Frameworks-level fix matching the maintainer recommendation on the bug: kguiaddons gains a binary-compatible KIconUtils::addOverlays() overload taking a target iconSize (clamping overlays to the painted icon bounds) and KIO's KFilePreviewGenerator passes m_viewAdapter->iconSize(), fixing both Folder View and file dialogs consistently across aspect ratios and HiDPI scales. Before/after screenshots and tests verify the fix cleanly. (Minor non-blocking nits: prefer !m_iconSize.isEmpty() over isValid(), use CCBUG: 499363 on the kguiaddons commit so the bug is closed by the kio commit, and consider adding a unit test in kiconutilstest.)
